document_title: Bybit hack and crypto security risk note
summary: Chainalysis mid-year crime update highlights the Bybit hack as evidence of advanced persistent threats to major crypto venues. The report warns that large security incidents may weigh on ETH and exchange-linked market liquidity via security risk, liquidation concern, negative sentiment, and short-term outflow pressure.

events.title: Bybit hack raises security and liquidity concerns for ETH
events.body: Chainalysis cites the Bybit hack as evidence of ongoing advanced persistent threats to major crypto venues, noting potential negative impacts on ETH and exchange-linked market liquidity including security risk, liquidation concern, negative sentiment, and short-term outflow pressure.
evidence: Chainalysis discussed the Bybit hack as evidence that sophisticated crypto venues remain exposed to advanced persistent threats.
For ETH and exchange-linked market liquidity, a large hack can raise security risk, liquidation concern, negative sentiment, and short-term outflow pressure.
The note mentions ETH directly so the ingestion pipeline should map it to ETHUSDT while retaining risk-event language for text feature generation.
